entities.summary: Yang Kaihui was the second wife of Mao Zedong, whom he married in 1920. She had three children with him: Mao Anying, Mao Anqing and Mao Anlong. Her father was Yang Changji, the head of the Hunan First Normal School and one of Mao's favorite teachers. She was a distant cousin to Yang Youlin, another instrumental member of the Chinese Communist Party.
